completion_requires: stateful clarification dialogue with validated operator responses and confirmation or cancellation
event-driven mission lifecycle and status updates derived from explicit simulation events
preflight and runtime re-evaluation of battery, availability, altitude, and restricted-area evidence
operator confirmation, pause, resume, cancellation, and safety intervention paths
unfinished work preserved for replanning after failures or state changes
route-aware restricted-area enforcement rather than target-only map-role checks
inter-drone separation or collision handling evaluated in the software simulation
bounded integration interfaces for speech or text, trained intent extraction, grounding, planning, scheduling, vision results, safety, and supervision
raw transition logs, failures, parameters, input hashes, and aggregate evaluations stored
at least one multi-snapshot telemetry sequence crosses from safe separation to a blocked state
synthetic battery, altitude, route-margin, and separation thresholds receive a stored sensitivity analysis
focused and full repository tests pass
research_scope_limits: synthetic policy thresholds require explicit sensitivity analysis or documented justification
Week 8 remains responsible for the full roadmap scenario and overall system metrics
